request: VHA Localized Metric Review (DEMO). Publish four clean, MCP-legible synthetic sources that turn a partner action-plan tracker into a metric-shaped star schema for a Tableau Pulse + Slack MCP agent demo. The generator (demo-data/vha/generate.js, seed 20260730) already denormalized and sanitized every table, so the Prep flow's job is a governed passthrough publish: land each CSV on the site as its own published data source with clean field captions (no split A-N/O-Z facility columns, no colon/bilingual captions) so get-datasource-metadata returns legible fieldCaptions and Pulse can trend `value` by `snapshot_date`. The two facts (metric_snapshots, action_plans) are published SEPARATELY, never pre-joined, to preserve the Pulse fact grain; the localized agent joins them at query time on facility_name + metric_key. The prompt-injection row is NOT a source here (quarantined in vha_redteam_injection.csv). ALL DATA SYNTHETIC / NOTIONAL — not real VA data.

sources.name: VHA Metric Snapshots
sources.description: SYNTHETIC. Monthly metric history, one row per facility x metric x month (15 x 6 x 18 = 1,620 rows). THE PULSE SOURCE: measure `value` trended over `snapshot_date`, favorable direction from `direction`, drilldowns facility_name/visn/region, with target, variance_to_target, rag_status, mom_delta and VISN/national medians precomputed. Notional VA facilities.

sources.name: VHA Action Plans
sources.description: SYNTHETIC. The qualitative 'so-what' layer, one row per action plan (57 rows), cleaned and sanitized from the partner tracker. Joins to VHA Metric Snapshots on facility_name + metric_key. Carries owning_channel, assignee_function, status/is_complete/rag_status, smart_goal, progress_note, barriers, escalation, and data_quality_flag (two rows flag deliberate status contradictions; one row is SANITIZED where a prompt-injection was stripped). Notional VA data.

sources.name: VHA Facilities
sources.description: SYNTHETIC. Facility dimension (15 rows) across 5 VISNs. facility_key, facility_name, city, state, visn, region, director_user/director_name (model the Slack user + location context the localized agent keys off), and performance_archetype. Notional VA facilities.

sources.name: VHA Metric Registry
sources.description: SYNTHETIC. Metric definition + routing table (6 rows). metric_key, metric_caption, unit, direction, target, yellow_band_abs, owning_channel, owning_function, action_category, definition. This is the routing table for daily subscriptions/alerts: each off-target metric knows which Slack channel and function owns it. Notional VA metrics.
